entities.summary: Anna Julia Hede Wilkens is a Swedish film director, photographer and former child actress, well known for her role as Fia in Den vita stenen. In 1986–89, she studied at Dramatiska Institutet. Now she works as teacher at Täby Enskilda gymnasium. She hosts the TV program Nyfiken.
